subject.title: SSRF guard pinned DNS dispatcher causes model fetch timeouts when autoSelectFamily is enabled

question: Should automatic `{ all: true }` pinned DNS lookups expose the complete already SSRF-validated IPv4-first address set to Node/Undici while ordinary single-result automatic lookups remain IPv4-only?
rationale: This chooses the permanent security and availability contract between the prior IPv4-unreachable-host safeguard and the newly reproduced IPv4-route-unreachable case; source evidence supports the narrow implementation but cannot select the policy tradeoff alone.

options.title: Approve the narrow dual-stack fallback contract
options.body: Review and land the candidate approach after current-main real-network proof confirms IPv4-only hosts remain protected and validated IPv6 is used only as an automatic fallback.

options.title: Keep IPv4-only automatic behavior
options.body: Retain the existing policy and document a supported operational workaround, accepting that some dual-stack provider routes remain unavailable.

recommendation.title: Approve the narrow dual-stack fallback contract
recommendation.body: Review and land the candidate approach after current-main real-network proof confirms IPv4-only hosts remain protected and validated IPv6 is used only as an automatic fallback.

likelyOwner.reason: They introduced the current automatic IPv4-preference contract that the decision modifies.
